_comment: Copy this to <your repo>/video/narration.json, then replace every <PLACEHOLDER>. generate-narration.py refuses to synthesize while any < or > remains. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the pipeline.
_comment_provider: elevenlabs reads the key from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, then XI_API_KEY, then ELEVEN_LABS_KEY. google uses the gcloud access token of whoever is logged in, and reads languageCode, voice and speakingRate instead.
_comment_beats: Seven beats, one per thing a judge has to be told. captionText is what the viewer reads. speechText is what the voice says. They are separate fields on purpose: captions carry the exact product names, spellings and figures a judge will check, and speech carries the spelled-out form a TTS engine pronounces correctly. So DataHub in a caption is Data Hub in speech, MCP is M C P, PR 183 is pull request one eighty three. Contract: each field 20 to 800 characters, ids matching [a-z][a-z-]{1,24}, each beat 3 to 40 seconds of measured speech, whole video 90 to 174 seconds. The real length of this template with a real voice has NOT been measured, so do not plan around a number for it: run the generator once and read the total it prints. It fails outside the 90 to 174 second window and tells you the measured figure, so cut or add words after that first run rather than guessing. Record the browser capture only after you know the total, because the capture must be at least trimLeadSeconds plus that total or the build will reject it.

segments._beat: The problem, in the buyer's words. Name a segment, never a market. Nigerian poultry and catfish farms, not SMBs.
segments.captionText: An owner-operator trucking firm running three to twelve trucks cannot close its books, because a broker does not pay per load. It pays once a fortnight, one bank credit covering eight loads, minus a factoring fee charged on the whole batch. The bank shows one number. The books need eight.
segments.speechText: An owner operator trucking firm running three to twelve trucks cannot close its books, because a broker does not pay per load. It pays once a fortnight. One bank credit, covering eight loads, minus a factoring fee charged on the whole batch. The bank shows one number. The books need eight.

segments._beat: The surface the buyer already opens. If the answer only ever appears on a page we built, this beat is a lie and the entry has shipped a twelfth tab.
segments.captionText: So the month arrives where the owner already reads their mail. Not a console they have to remember to open, because on the first of the month a haulier is driving.
segments.speechText: So the month arrives where the owner already reads their mail. Not a console they have to remember to open, because on the first of the month, a haulier is driving.

segments._beat: What fires without anyone asking. A product nobody has to remember to open beats a product with a better interface.
segments.captionText: Nobody presses anything. A month of documents lands in a Cloud Storage bucket, Eventarc wakes a Cloud Run container, and a Google ADK agent starts work.
segments.speechText: Nobody presses anything. A month of documents lands in a Cloud Storage bucket, Eventarc wakes a Cloud Run container, and a Google A D K agent starts work.

segments._beat: The anonymous path executing the flagship claim, not a neighbour of it. This is the beat the browser capture must actually be showing.
segments.captionText: Ten steps, unattended. It classifies 27 artifacts, posts the journal, splits the remittance across the eight loads it settles, and proves it: what landed equals what the lines pay, less the fee charged once. Then it finds a broker that paid 200 dollars light, a truck stop that charged 412.85 twice, and 1,865 dollars that left the account with nothing behind it.
segments.speechText: Ten steps, unattended. It classifies twenty seven artifacts, posts the journal, splits the remittance across the eight loads it settles, and proves it. What landed equals what the lines pay, less the fee charged once. Then it finds a broker that paid two hundred dollars light, a truck stop that charged four hundred and twelve dollars twice, and one thousand eight hundred and sixty five dollars that left the account with nothing behind it.

segments._beat: One sentence naming how the sponsor's product is load-bearing. If removing it leaves the app working, it is not the hero and the entry will not place.
segments.captionText: Remove Google ADK and there is no agent, only a function somebody has to remember to run. Remove Firestore and a container that scales to zero between months has nowhere to keep the trail. Gemini reads the documents and writes the English. It never touches a figure.
segments.speechText: Remove Google A D K and there is no agent, only a function somebody has to remember to run. Remove Firestore and a container that scales to zero between months has nowhere to keep the trail. Gemini reads the documents and writes the English. It never touches a figure.

segments._beat: What a judge can check without asking us. Every claimed capability is reachable by an anonymous judge, or labelled not-deployed in the same sentence.
segments.captionText: Every number came from a deterministic ledger. 214 offline tests, no key and no network. Each of the five gates is broken on purpose once and asserted red, because a gate nobody has watched fail is a gate nobody should believe.
segments.speechText: Every number came from a deterministic ledger. Two hundred and fourteen offline tests, no key and no network. Each of the five gates is broken on purpose once, and asserted red, because a gate nobody has watched fail is a gate nobody should believe.

segments._beat: The one sentence to be republished. One mechanism, one consequence, nothing else. Organizers quote this almost verbatim, so write it first and cut it last.
segments.captionText: Archon splits one broker payment back across the eight loads it settles and files the letters chasing what was underpaid, so the owner wakes up to a closed month in their inbox instead of a shoebox they will get to in April.
